study type: analytical survey using a case-control approach
cohort: This study included 15,173 respondents from the Indonesian Demographic Health Survey (IDHS) in 2012.
finding: There was no association found between maternal age and antepartum hemorrhage, but a significant relationship was observed between history of cesarean section and antepartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: History of cesarean section was significantly associated with antepartum hemorrhage.
